rationale.edition: OSS. All 11 changed files live under web/src/ — the open-source frontend. No enterprise-owned paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) are touched, and no enterprise keywords (cipher, SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, sensitive-data, logo-management) appear in the changed file paths.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change removes the legacy pipe-based query splitting from the search bar across Logs and Traces, which is a user-facing behavioral change. The trigger comment is empty and no skip label was provided. The diff adds Vitest unit tests but no explicit opt-out marker.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The search bar's query parsing logic is changed: the pipe character is no longer treated as a function/where clause separator. A user typing match_all('text | error') will now preserve the pipe as part of the search term rather than having it silently split. This affects the user-visible behavior of the search bar, index list field-value filter appending, and traces search. An end-to-end test should verify that queries with pipes are preserved intact, filter terms append correctly, and search results reflect the new parsing behavior in a real browser session.
rationale.area: Logs. The heaviest frontend changes are in web/src/plugins/logs/ (SearchBar.vue, IndexList.vue), the shared composable useQuery.ts is Logs-facing, and the closest sibling Playwright E2E spec is logsqueries.matchall.spec.js already under the Logs area. The change also touches Traces (Index.vue, IndexList.vue, SearchBar.vue, filterUtils.ts) but the primary user interaction and the most impactful watcher change are in the Logs search bar.
rationale.group: Logs-Queries. The existing logsqueries.matchall.spec.js lives in this group (ci_matrix_cloud.json), and the feature is a query-parsing change directly related to match_all behavior with piped terms. Sibling specs like logsqueries.cte.spec.js and logsqueries.spec.js reinforce that query-engine changes belong here.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The changed .spec.ts files (IndexList.spec.ts, SearchBar.addSearchTerm.spec.ts, Index.spec.ts, filterUtils.spec.ts, useQuery.spec.ts — all under web/src/) are Vitest unit tests, not E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. The developer has thorough unit coverage for the query-parsing logic but no end-to-end tests.
